acceptance_scope: Remote OK implemented and verified as an independently traceable global job-source adapter under MJ-REQ-017. Declares exact capabilities (PUBLIC_JSON: DISCOVERY, JOB_DETAIL, SALARY, REMOTE_METADATA, APPLICATION_REDIRECT) and disallows unsupported features (DIRECT_APPLICATION, APPLICATION_STATUS). Normalizes multi-company job postings, salary bounds/currencies, tags into skills, employment type, and location/remote metadata into canonical search semantics. Integrated into source registry and collection engine with deterministic contract fixtures and bounded live read-only verification.
acceptance_behavior: Remote OK adapter declares CollectionStrategy.PUBLIC_JSON and supported capabilities: DISCOVERY, JOB_DETAIL, SALARY, REMOTE_METADATA, APPLICATION_REDIRECT.
Unsupported features including DIRECT_APPLICATION and APPLICATION_STATUS return False according to capability contract.

Public API endpoint https://remoteok.com/api is fetched with rate limiting, monotonic clock intervals, timeout budgets, and status tracking (HEALTHY, SOURCE_TIMEOUT, SOURCE_NETWORK_ERROR, SOURCE_RATE_LIMITED, SOURCE_SERVER_ERROR, SOURCE_PAYLOAD_INVALID).
Per-job multi-company attribution is preserved using SourceCompany with identity parts ('remoteok', company_slug) and domain https://remoteok.com.
Skills, location regions/countries, remote status, employment type, salary min/max bounds and currency, and HTML-sanitized descriptions are normalized to canonical search semantics.
Single job fetch retrieves and normalizes specific job postings by posting ID.
Client-side and query-parameter tag filtering and limits operate over the public API inventory.
Registry source_adapter recognizes provider 'remoteok' (and alias 'remote_ok') and configure_source supports 'remoteok' with persistent job source configuration.
Operation cancellation callbacks are polled during rate-limit sleep and request execution.
Bounded live read-only validation verified against live Remote OK public API without anti-bot or access-control bypasses.
